description:
Our project tells the stories of NASA’s abandoned equipment on the Moon and Mars.
It explores old rovers, landers, and space missions.
Users can discover their missions, achievements, and what happened to them.
The goal is to make space exploration fun and educational through interactive storytelling.
summary: Our project, "Abandoned but not Forgotten," is an interactive platform that maps and tells the stories of NASA’s discarded equipment on the Moon and Mars. Using official NASA open data, it transforms inactive landers, rovers, and scientific instruments into engaging educational narratives, bridging humanity's space exploration history with future missions in the simplest possible way.
details: We built an interactive web experience using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and official NASA archives (PDS, Apollo Lunar Surface Journal, and NASA 3D Resources). Users explore virtual maps of the Moon and Mars to click on abandoned hardware—like Apollo 17's descent stage and rovers—to discover their scientific purpose, coordinates, and stories. This creative storytelling approach preserves space heritage and makes complex space history accessible and inspiring.
